name: mnemoverse
description: Persistent memory for AI agents, shared across tools. Connects the hosted Mnemoverse memory server over MCP with a one-time OAuth sign-in: recall relevant memories before acting, save durable decisions and corrections, keep shared memory rooms across accounts. Bundles the CC0 agent-memory-discipline skill so the agent actually uses the memory it has.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent memory shared across AI coding tools
interface.longDescription: Hosted persistent memory for AI agents over MCP. Tell it a recalled memory helped or misled, and it re-ranks what comes back next. Shared rooms for multi-agent work. One key or OAuth across Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and ChatGPT. The bundled CC0 agent-memory-discipline skill tells the agent when to recall and what is worth saving.
defaultPrompt: Recall what we decided about this module in past sessions.
Save the decisions from this session that are worth keeping.
Show my memory stats and the newest memories.
